concept: Transfer the measured scanning-susceptometry reproduction pipeline

source_evidence.simulation_archive_interpretation: 81 rows of one 65-by-81 scan, not independent device or dataset families
source_evidence.visible_shortcut: The official notebook performs one linear phase correction, one Gaussian noise fit, background subtraction and image rotation/translation around a cached forward image.

decision: Do not construct a nominal second pilot that already fails mandatory gates. Manufacturing five families from this single acquisition would require prohibited seed/row/noise variants or a synthetic inverse problem detached from the central empirical workflow.
